text.Timeless Livingで叶えた漆喰の家で暮らす夢: A dream of living in a house of lime plaster, come true
text.A様ご夫妻はご主人が京都、奥様が浅草のご出身。漆喰の寺社や家屋を身近に育ったおふ: Mr A grew up in Kyoto, Mrs A in Asakusa. Both were raised among temples, shrines and houses built in lime plaster, and lime plaster was the first condition they set for their new home. With renovation already in mind they chose a seventeen-year-old apartment in the quiet residential streets of Mejiro. A full skeleton renovation by Timeless Living gave a plan that balances enclosure and openness, and with every room finished in lime plaster the result is clean and comfortable. The Scandinavian furniture and the plants they chose together suit it well.
text.──Timeless Living に依頼された経緯を教えていただけますか？: — Could you tell us how you came to work with Timeless Living?
text.漆喰を塗ってもらえるリフォーム会社を探していたところ、そういう会社のホームページ: We were looking for a renovation company that would work in lime plaster, and the sites of the firms we found were full of projects in a sort of country-guesthouse style, which was not what we had in mind. Then an estate agent told us there was a good company, and introduced us to Timeless Living. Looking at the site, the work was so beautiful that we were almost put off approaching them — but we telephoned and went to the showroom.
text.その頃、ほかにもいくつかの会社に当たっていて、最終的にTimeless Livi: We were approaching several firms at the time, and in the end narrowed it to three, Timeless Living among them, and asked each for a design. And in fact we settled on a different company first — but something about it never sat right.
text.そこで急遽、Timeless Livingさんにもう一度時間を作ってもらい、会っ: So at short notice we asked Timeless Living for another meeting, and talking to them we felt again that we saw things the same way, that it fitted. We withdrew from the company we had chosen and asked Timeless Living instead. The other firm was not bad at all. They listened well — I had lived in England, and when I said I wanted the cornice moulding one often sees in English homes, they came back with the design detail in no time.
text.一方で、Timeless Livingさんの提示はモールディングを付けないものだ: Timeless Living, on the other hand, proposed no moulding at all. This house does not need it, they said.
text.施主の希望であっても、やめたほうがいいと思ったら、はっきり言う。自信があるからこ: Even when it is what the client has asked for, if they think it is better left out they say so plainly. Only confidence allows that. In the end we dropped the moulding — and had we put it in, I think it would have been too heavy for this house and we would have regretted it.
text.──実際にリフォームが始まってからはいかがでしたか？: — And how was it once the work actually started?
text.一緒につくっているという感じで、とても楽しかったです。私たちのイメージを上手く汲: It felt as though we were making it together, and it was thoroughly enjoyable. They took what we had in mind and, as professionals, made it real without fuss. They put forward the best scheme for what we wanted and what we could spend, and we were grateful for that.
text.たとえば、キッチンの床にはリビングのものよりリーズナブルな無垢材を薦められました: For instance, they recommended a less expensive solid timber for the kitchen floor than for the living room: a kitchen is bound to get dirty, and it is not a place where one can be careful. I thought they were quite right.
text.工事が始まってからも、「このドアはいいものだから色を塗り替えて使いましょう」と提: Even after work began they would suggest things — this door is a good one, let us repaint it and keep it — and they stayed flexible and attentive to the end. And perhaps we are simply shameless, but they have gone on advising us since the renovation finished. When we ordered a chest and told them the name of the furniture shop, they vouched for it: you will be fine there.
text.いいと思う感覚が近いのでしょうか。玄関や寝室に飾っている陶板作品はTimeles: Perhaps our sense of what is good is close to theirs. The ceramic panels in the entrance and the bedroom we bought at an exhibition Timeless Living held at their showroom. They are by a Swedish artist; we fell for them and bought four.
text.──当初のご希望どおり、すべての部屋を漆喰になさったご感想はいかがですか。: — You got your original wish of lime plaster in every room. How has that been?
text.Timeless Livingさんオリジナルの漆喰は期待していた以上で、クローゼ: Timeless Living's own lime plaster exceeded what we had hoped for, and we are very glad we took it into the wardrobes and the shoe cupboard as well. It absorbs smells remarkably; even the particular smell of dry-cleaned clothes fades away if they hang in the wardrobe.
text.煙草の臭いのついた服もクローゼットに吊しておくと、2、3日で臭いが取れるので、び: Clothes that smell of cigarettes lose it in two or three days hanging in the wardrobe, which astonished me. The shoe cupboard has no smell at all. Apparently the plaster breaks the compounds down. And because it regulates humidity, the windows do not run with condensation, which impressed me. In photographs we were shown when we bought the apartment they were streaming; now it is only a little on the aluminium frames.
text.あと、光が違います。写真に撮ってみるとよくわかりますが、きれいに映るんです。漆喰: The light is different, too. You see it clearly in photographs — things come out beautifully. It is apparently because the plaster scatters the light; it is enough to make you think your photography has improved.
text.──漆喰以外で気に入っている部分を教えていただけますか。: — Apart from the plaster, what else are you pleased with?
text.ベランダの白い窓枠と白いウッドブラインドが気に入っています。この家に決めた理由の: I love the white window frames and the white wooden blinds on the balcony side. One reason we chose this home was the cherry tree right in front of the balcony, and because everything around the window is white, it shows beautifully. We eat breakfast at the dining table by the glass every morning and look at it.
text.窓から降り注ぐ朝陽の中に座って、ぼーっと桜を眺めてる時間は至福ですね。家から出た: Sitting in the morning sun coming through the window, gazing at the cherry and thinking of nothing, is bliss. It makes you not want to leave the house.
text.主人はよく「いかん、いかん」と言いながら出かけていきますね。休みの日の朝は、ふた: My husband often leaves saying, no, no, this will not do. On a free morning the two of us sit at that table for an hour or so.
text.桜は寝室からも見えるんですよ。寝室とリビングをつなぐウォークスルークローゼットの: You can see the cherry from the bedroom too. Leave the doors of the walk-through wardrobe between the bedroom and the living room open, and you can look at it from bed.
text.満開の頃は格別です。: In full bloom it is something else.
text.無垢材のフローリングも気に入っています。驚いたのが、はずして持って行けるようにつ: We like the solid timber flooring too. What surprised us is that it is built so that it can be lifted and taken with us — because it is fixed not with adhesive but with screws you cannot see from above.
text.洗面台もはずして持っていけると聞きました。: We are told the washstand can be taken too.
text.どちらも「引っ越すことになった場合も持っていけます」と言われましたが、今のところ: We were told of both that we could take them if we ever moved. For the moment it looks unlikely we shall make use of that. We have no intention of leaving this house at all (laughs)
text.自家製のおいしい梅ジュースでもてなしてくださった奥様と、「桜の木にやってくるシジ: Mrs A received us with an excellent home-made plum cordial; Mr A told us he enjoys watching the tits, white-eyes and starlings that come to the cherry tree. From the way they took turns to tell the story, and from the carefully chosen furniture and objects about the house, we came away with a sense of a careful, rich life, and of a couple who are close. May the home they took their time to choose and to build go on being a place of great happiness for them both.
